senses.gloss: f. (ἱλάρια) day of rejoicing, both private and public; esp. days of public rejoicings appointed by a new emperor, consisting of games, masquerades &c. Pesik. Sh’mini p. 193ᵇ while the King is engaged בא׳ שלו וכ׳ in his hilaria, ask of him what you need.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:2">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>לא היו עומדין באלירא וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) (at Mount Sinai) they did not stand (as) in hilaria, but in awe, trembling &c.
